name: jetski-race
note: the race from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on a water with a wave mask; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-beach
note: beached on the sand, nose inland, throttle and stick: the craft drives back to the water in about 3 s (it spun on the spot, 8 s and no metres, before); control: no throttle does not count as driving off

name: jetski-handling
note: the handling, by real input on a software GL: a tighter carve when leaning back, a price for over-steering, the rider working, landings that matter, the course area; each with its own comparison

name: jetski-menu
note: the menus by real input, pad and keyboard: every page and back, pause with restart and quit, championship points, a time trial alone; controls: nothing finished pays nothing, a championship keeps its rivals

name: jetski-sound
note: Cold Sound from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on the second course; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-ramps
note: the ramps never float: a race's worth of ticks at the biggest sea of every difficulty on both courses, nine points a side against the water every tick; control: lifted 2.1 m, the check sees gaps
